text: Underway in round nine.
Robodinho calling immediately to take charge of the opening ball in the centre circle.
BellingRAM bursts right through on the right flank!
Robodinho loses balance in defence, tumbling flat to the turf.
A venomous strike from distance, and it whistles just wide of the target!
Singularity United are absolutely pinning the reds deep inside their own third here.
BellingRAM calls out, looking to prise the ball off the perimeter boards.
BellingRAM bundles it home from point-blank range! Singularity United lead!
Synthetic Athletic are completely trapped right now, unable to clear the lines as the sky blues swarm forward again.
Haalandroid breaks completely clear through the right channel with vast swathes of empty carpet ahead!
Haalandroid gathers composure, driving the ball steadily forward along the left flank.
Griezmatronn gives a shout to the teammate, intent on working the ball along the boundary wall. Both of these founding clubs playing entirely unchanged, no tactical updates since day one.
Griezmatronn calls out, stepping up quickly to apply pressure on the edge of the defensive zone.
The powered push-panel rattles and fires the ball back into play.
Robodinho finds an enormous pocket of space right through the middle and breaks away into clear turf!
Robodinho sprints directly at goal!
Robodinho finishes in style! Synthetic Athletic are level!
Synthetic Athletic keep their foot on the pedal, holding United under real sustained pressure in the attacking third.
BellingRAM finds an opening from deep on the right and charges directly at the exposed red defence!
Robodinho calls out to Griezmatronn, working diligently to scrap the ball off the touchline wall.
BellingRAM drives hard down the right wing into space.
Inches away! A rasping effort grazes the outside of the post and bounces clear!
United pressing high again.
The corner ram triggers with an almighty clatter, firing the ball back across the penalty area.
BellingRAM is clean through on goal again!
Fires just wide of the post!
BellingRAM makes no mistake this time! A second goal just before the break, and United reclaim the lead!
Robodinho is flattened in a heavy
Haalandroid calls to work the ball
Robodinho returns the favour, leaving Haalandroid sprawled on the deck.
Robodinho stumbles to the deck.
The buzzer sounds! All four fold up instantly, but the magenta ball rolls
The ball stops in midfield. Remember, the buzzer cuts power dead, leaving all four inert, but the ball remains live until it settles. Singularity United lead 2-1 at the break.
BellingRAM strikes just wide!
BellingRAM pounces instantly on the rebound to claim a third goal for Singularity United.
A wild drive flashes harmlessly wide.
BellingRAM converts from close range once again, stretching Singularity United's advantage to four goals to one.
The corner panel activates, launching the magenta ball back across the penalty spot.
Robodinho calls to wrestle it off the boundary.
A messy tangle between teammates, and Haalandroid ends up flat on the turf.
BellingRAM simply overbalances in the defensive zone and will need a moment to right itself.
Robodinho drives into space through the centre of the pitch.
Robodinho slips it into the net! A second goal for the striker, and Synthetic Athletic trim the deficit to two.
Griezmatronn steps in with a solid challenge to topple BellingRAM.
BellingRAM responds in kind, knocking Griezmatronn over in the corner with time running dangerously thin for Athletic.
Griezmatronn slips and crashes down in the middle.
A miscommunication in red as Robodinho collides clumsily with Griezmatronn.
Haalandroid calls out from deep, holding possession tight against the boards.
The push-panel delivers a sharp shove, ejecting the ball back into the channel.
Haalandroid winds down the clock, carrying the ball neatly up the touchline.
BellingRAM sweeps home a fifth for Singularity United with barely sixty seconds remaining on the clock.
Robodinho bundles it in! A lifeline for Synthetic Athletic, but they are running out of time!
BellingRAM tucks home yet another from close range to put the result completely beyond doubt.
The buzzer sounds, power is cut dead, and the ball drifts through midfield.
